gloss: fish meat; fish flesh (as food product)

definitions.gloss: the flesh of fish, considered as a food ingredient — especially used as a generic or categorical term, or in processed-food names
definitions.explanation: A slightly technical or categorical word for fish as meat, in contrast to {肉|にく} when it refers to livestock meat. Commonly seen on food labels and in processed-food names like {魚肉|ぎょにく}ソーセージ (fish sausage) or {魚肉|ぎょにく}ハム. Much less common in everyday cooking speech, where people simply say {魚|さかな}.

examples.japanese: {魚肉|ぎょにく}ソーセージが{好|す}きだ。
{魚肉|ぎょにく}は{高|たか}タンパクで{低|てい}カロリーだ。
examples.english: Fish meat is high in protein and low in calories.

examples.japanese: この{練|ね}り{物|もの}は{魚肉|ぎょにく}を{主|しゅ}{原料|げんりょう}としている。
examples.english: This processed product is made primarily from fish meat.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}は、お{弁当|べんとう}に{魚肉|ぎょにく}ソーセージがよく{入|はい}っていた。
examples.english: When I was a kid, fish sausages were often in my lunchbox.

notes:
Compound of {魚|ぎょ} ("fish") + {肉|にく} ("meat, flesh"). Treats fish as a category of meat. The word is somewhat technical and appears more in food-industry, nutritional, and processed-product contexts than in everyday speech.

USAGE:
- In everyday conversation, people normally say {魚|さかな} when talking about eating fish — not {魚肉|ぎょにく}.
- Extremely common as the first half of compound product names: {魚肉|ぎょにく}ソーセージ, {魚肉|ぎょにく}ハム, {魚肉|ぎょにく}{練製品|ねりせいひん} (fish paste products).
- Used in nutrition and cooking-science discussions to classify food types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}ソーセージ: fish sausage
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}ハム: fish ham
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}{加工|かこう}{品|ひん}: processed fish products
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}{練製品|ねりせいひん}: fish paste products (kamaboko, chikuwa, etc.)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {魚|さかな}: fish — the everyday word, used whether alive, raw, or cooked.
- {肉|にく}: meat — typically livestock meat (beef, pork, chicken); contrasts with {魚肉|ぎょにく}.
- {畜肉|ちくにく}: livestock meat — the technical counterpart to {魚肉|ぎょにく}.
- {白身|しろみ}/{赤身|あかみ}: white-fleshed / red-fleshed (fish) — describe types of fish flesh.
